status: compiled-declaration-pending; worker local gates pass, Root acceptance/integration pending
remarks: Portable source port only: original inheritance/object/vtable layout, ARM calling convention/binary interoperability and hardware are unresolved/unverified. Ordinary return declarations for both original methods remain unresolved; void is provisional. Exact mangling does not promote original declaration readiness.

Native execution runs only exact hash/range-verified original EQ draw and BackgroundPainter paint instructions. Provider View/Style/Parameter/math/renderer and accepted drawCurve/getBandEnabled boundaries are intercepted before execution. Native fixtures are independently generated without reconstructed C++ or pseudocode; intercepted drawCurve boundary models its accepted flat pixel curve clipping and separately records all original call arguments. This is compositional evidence, not full ARM integrated rendering.

Native dirty clear uses original RGB565 renderer; source owns actual CCL RGBA Bitmap and deliberately uses ColorBitmapRenderer. RGB565 quantization, original alpha and universal pixel equality are unclaimed. Static native black storage is zero-initialized in mapped ELF, its fill argument is captured/checked; runtime static constructor color/alpha and Core instructions are not emulated. Source black uses pinned CCL Colors::kBlack. Provider pixel checks are separate from native argument equivalence.

Native handles test positive intersection but pass full rectangles/source slice/destination to Graphics; real DrawEvent constructor binds provider clip. Root confirmed preservation rather than manual call-argument clipping. Unsupported frame counts center using full image height then slice by actual count; preserved and tested with frameCount2.

One-band state and two ordered painters are exercised. No concurrent/reentrant vector resize, dangling/null painter, invalid/zero frame count, negative sizes, allocation failure/EH, corrupt receiver or hardware/system-call behavior claim. Selected and active numeric fixture values are 0/1; primary missing/0/1. Painter overrides are test-only class fixtures; production retains real virtual BackgroundPainter behavior and borrowed lifetime.

Existing canonical EQ drawCurve/rebuild/initBands/constructor/attributes source and dependencies remain in place. New native/provider observations do not replace earlier proof bindings; Root must refresh affected proof, canonical Linux integration, installed-role/compile-once, source placement, guarded pending admission and tracker/mirror gates. No global readiness admission performed by worker.
retry_condition: Authoritative original return declaration for readiness promotion; Root canonical integration and guarded admission. Broader state domains require new native/provider fixtures.

resolved_observations.observation: Native full-rectangle call after overlap-only clip guard differs from initial prose contract.
resolved_observations.resolution: Root confirmed exact native arguments plus real DrawEvent/provider clip. Cases cover disjoint/touch and partial intersection.

resolved_observations.observation: FrameCount2 centers full height but native source rectangle divides by actual frame count.
resolved_observations.resolution: Preserved distinct geometry and source slice; independent exact ARM cases cover full/partial/outside/touch clips.

resolved_observations.observation: Initial source fixture expected a clip narrower than event updateRect and used stack Style owned by View.
resolved_observations.resolution: Pinned CCL DrawEvent resets renderer clip to updateRect; View destructor owns Style. Fixture now uses actual event clip and heap-owned copied Style.
